text_block_list.name: Uma Girl A
text_block_list.text: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience! Due to an accident, we are currently experiencing a power shortage and have temporarily suspended the performance!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Eh... are they okay? It looks serious... Is there anything we can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl A
text_block_list.text: For those who need to move, we’ll hand out flashlights! Please feel free—oh, would you like one? Having some light might make you feel safer!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: No, I’m fine... but... having some light... makes me feel calm...

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, mister, what are you doing? If you keep your phone light on, the battery’s gonna run out, you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Ah, this... how should I say it? I just want them to feel safe!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: --! Then I’ll do it too! Wait, if everyone does it, wouldn’t it get pretty bright!?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Lights began to flicker one by one throughout the darkened venue. Before realizing it, I had raised my phone’s flashlight too—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if to cheer for the girls who had entertained us until now. Before long, the audience seats had turned into a dazzling sea of light—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I was supposed to give them something... but I ended up receiving it instead.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: But that’s right! That’s what Marvelous is!! Something everyone creates☆ Something everyone discovers★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That’s why this sea of light everyone made is also the crystallization of our Marvelous...—Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey! I just thought of it! A way to reach the biggest Marvelous ever☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha☆ Thank you, everyone! This sparkling sea—it’s sooooo Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I’ve been able to walk this far! Because your lights guided me—so I won’t lose my way to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: And you know what? Have you noticed? The sea of light you all created... it’s reflected above too. Look up, at the ceiling!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Can’t see it yet?—Ahaha. Then I’ll show you right now! Here we goーーー☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl A
text_block_list.text: It’s coming...! Everyone, ready? On my cue...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous and the others
text_block_list.text: 3, 2, 1! MAAARVELOUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Waaah!? What’s this... the circus tent is!!!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (...What brilliant improvisation. If they can’t project the deep sea, tying it to the sea of light given by the audience—and using the real starry sky instead...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I’m glad... that this is Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Thanks to the clear air, the stars and moon are functioning as part of the stage. With this much brightness, they can truly show the performance they envisioned.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (...Heh. Maybe from the very moment they decided to perform here, this grand finale was destined to happen...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One month before the circus performance—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Actually! The circus—I want to hold it in Hokkaido☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? The circus, in Hokkaido...? What do you mean? Isn’t that for the Sacred Hoof Festival? Wouldn’t that normally be held at the academy?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that’s right! But Marvelous has to reach the whole country!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So let’s go beyond☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A-are you serious...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Of course! Marvelous can be conveyed even through a screen! But still, I want to meet everyone out there in person!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because when you hand-deliver it, Marvelous becomes even moooore Marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: People who can’t see the festival! People who can’t watch races live! What if the circus came to them?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha☆ They’d be surprised for sure! Smiling from ear to ear! That’s truly Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So if such wonderful things are waiting—then we have to go☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha. Wow. You’re serious?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That’s awesome! Damn, that’s some crazy good vibes!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I understand your passion. But as things stand, even holding the circus itself has raised concerns about ‘personnel’ and ‘safety.’

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And if we hold it outside the academy... naturally, the issues we must overcome will be far greater than for any event held within school grounds.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that’s true! That’s why—everyone together! Let’s make it happen! Oh☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Fuji~! Great job! Ahaha☆ The stream was super fun! Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! That’s exactly the feedback I wanted to hear.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way. The promotion went well too. People from other regions who watched the stream have started applying to join as staff!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The recruitment on Umatta!? Yayーーー☆ It reached them, Marvelous! To everyone out there!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, all that effort paid off. With this, we might be able to gather enough local staff.

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: Yeah... alright! The success rate just shot up! At this rate, even the real show—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaarvelous☆★☆ Everyone’s performance is perfect now! Thanks to Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Eh~? That’s not true~. I just helped everyone relax a little.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I get it though, when you’re going all the way out there, you can’t help but think, ‘We can’t show them anything subpar!’

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That’s why this is everyone’s real strength. I’m just glad you can all show it now♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: We’re hereーーー☆ Hakodate, yeahーーー!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeeahーーー☆★☆ Tomorrow’s the big day! I hope tons of people come to see us★

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Riiight! Then let’s go check out the tent already♪ I’ll show you the way! It’s quicker from this exit!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oh! You seem familiar with this place! Have you been to this airport before?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I’ve raced here a few times. And, well...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That’s why I wanted to come back. One more time. Here.
